interpretation_rules.explicit_course_code: Course code appears in material metadata/content.
interpretation_rules.explicit_course_name: Course name or clear name variant appears in material metadata/content.
interpretation_rules.probable_legacy_course_material: Legacy lecture-series title pattern maps to a known course but should be reviewed if used as official evidence.
interpretation_rules.contextual_topic_or_pathway: Topic/pathway connection only; not a confirmed official course material link.
interpretation_rules.possible_teaching_material_no_confirmed_: Teaching-looking material without course code/name evidence.
interpretation_rules.canva_context_policy: Canva rows are linked to a course only when a course code or official course name is visible in the metadata. Broader topic matches are kept as possible teaching materials.

summary.deduplication: Mapped rows are collapsed to one row per material-course pair; strongest evidence type is retained and secondary matched terms are listed.
